# Dangerous Pretzel Co. (full notes)

> Soft pretzel shop in Salt Lake City. Fresh retail at the Post District counter, plus wholesale flash-frozen foodservice.

This file restates facts already published on dangerouspretzel.com. It does not add case packs, MOQs, unpublished prices, or ratings.

## Published shop facts

- Site: https://www.dangerouspretzel.com/v2/index.html
- Canonical host: https://www.dangerouspretzel.com (https://dangerouspretzel.com 301s to www; `/` 301s to `/v2/index.html`; short paths such as `/menu` and `/catering-menu` 301 to the `.html` URL)
- Shop: 352 W 600 S, Salt Lake City, UT 84101 (Post District)
- Hours (FAQ / location): Friday–Sunday 11am–8pm. Closed Monday–Thursday.
- Phone: (801) 916-0275
- Text: (385) 888-7603
- Email: info@dangerouspretzel.com
- Pickup ordering is linked from the site to Cash App
- FAQ: pretzels and dips are vegetarian; some items contain dairy and eggs; gluten-free is not currently offered
- Catering order form notice: Under $200: 12hr notice · $200–$500: 24hr notice · $500+: 48hr notice
- Catering page: delivery is offered in the SLC metro area (fee listed on that page)
- Wedding catering: pretzel boxes, bomb trays, and dips for cocktail hour, a late-night snack, rehearsal dinners, and receptions. Pickup at 352 W 600 S, or SLC metro delivery. The request is on the catering page and can be used any day for a future date. A closed shop counter does not block it. Notice is 12, 24, or 48 hours depending on order size.
- Office and corporate catering: one-off catering for meetings, team events, office parties, and client events in Salt Lake City. Pretzel boxes (15 per box), bomb trays (100 pretzel bombs per tray, 4–6 per serving, feeds 16–25), and dips. Pickup at 352 W 600 S, or SLC metro delivery ($75). Same request form and notice as the catering page. Not a standing wholesale account.
- Game-day catering: pretzel boxes, bomb trays, and dips for football and basketball watch parties, tailgates, team parties, and Jazz, Utes, or Real Salt Lake-style game nights at homes and offices in Salt Lake City. Pickup at 352 W 600 S, or SLC metro delivery ($75, listed on the catering page). Same request form. Notice on the catering page: Under $200: 12hr notice · $200–$500: 24hr notice · $500+: 48hr notice.
- Holiday party catering: pretzel boxes, bomb trays, and dips for holiday parties, company and office holiday parties, end-of-year team events, and family gatherings in Salt Lake City. Pickup at 352 W 600 S, or SLC metro delivery ($75, listed on the catering page). Same request form. Notice on the catering page: Under $200: 12hr notice · $200–$500: 24hr notice · $500+: 48hr notice. December dates are sent on that request when the party is on the calendar. The page does not add a separate December cutoff.
- Party catering: pretzel boxes, bomb trays, and dips for birthdays, baby showers, bridal showers, graduations, and similar private parties in Salt Lake City. Pickup at 352 W 600 S, or SLC metro delivery ($75, listed on the catering page). Same request form. Notice is 12, 24, or 48 hours depending on order size. The catering page lists which notice applies. The page does not restate the size tiers.

## Published wholesale facts

- Wholesale is fully baked in the Salt Lake City kitchen, then flash-frozen and vacuum-sealed. The site says they do not ship raw dough.
- Audience listed on the wholesale hub: restaurants and bars, offices and campuses, grocery and retail, event venues
- SLC metro: direct frozen delivery, including seven-day scheduling as described on the wholesale pages
- Outside the metro: freight partnerships
- Ordering: weekly standing orders or on-demand; minimums are set with the account, not posted as a public MOQ
- Fresh retail: shop bakes fresh daily; a 3-day shelf option is described for retail partners
- Assortment / case packs: confirmed when the account is set up; not published on the wholesale pages
- Direct wholesale vs distributor: one business stocking for its own guests vs a network carrying the brand in a region
- Pretzel Program: a separate venue lane (plug-in heated station), not the frozen-case wholesale path
- New wholesale accounts: inquiry form on the wholesale page, info@dangerouspretzel.com, or the shop phone / text numbers above
- Existing partners order at the wholesale portal (linked from the wholesale pages)
- Distributor page publishes 15+ wholesale partners and 50K+ pretzels sold monthly
- Spoke pages for grocery/retail, venues/concessions, bars/breweries, Intermountain foodservice, offices/campuses, reheat onboarding, the become-a-customer checklist, catering-vs-wholesale, vs-mall, add-to-menu, foodservice supplier, pretzel bombs, and Salt Lake restaurant wholesale all use the same wholesale inquiry form (on-page or the hub form)
- Reheat: partners reheat from frozen; the site does not publish oven temperatures, times, or frozen shelf-life days. The process is dialed in with each partner.
- Offices and campuses: listed wholesale audience; standing orders; no kitchen build-out. A one-off corporate lunch is catering, not wholesale.
- Catering vs wholesale: catering is pretzel boxes, bomb trays, and dips for a single event (order form notice: Under $200: 12hr notice · $200–$500: 24hr notice · $500+: 48hr notice). Wholesale is standing or on-demand frozen cases for a business stocking its own service.
- Vs mall / commodity: the hub already positions wholesale as “not a mall pretzel.” The shop pretzel is fully baked in SLC, flash-frozen, and vacuum-sealed; partners reheat. The site does not name competing brands or invent their specs.
- Adding pretzels to a restaurant menu: inquiry → assortment confirmed with the account → reheat dialed in with the line → standing or on-demand orders. Not catering, not the Pretzel Program station.
- Foodservice supplier: same wholesale product (fully baked, flash-frozen, vacuum-sealed). Direct path is SLC metro van or regional freight. Distributor inquiry lists SLC metro, Utah statewide, Mountain West, and national as application regions — not a published coverage map.
- Pretzel bombs: listed wholesale SKU family — bite-size for concessions, taprooms, and grab-and-go. Distributor product range includes 5 bomb varieties. A catering bomb tray is a one-off event order, not wholesale cases.
- Salt Lake restaurant wholesale: restaurant/bar menu job in the SLC metro (direct van from 352 W 600 S). The Utah page is metro-vs-freight logistics for any foodservice account. Walk-in retail remains a separate account.
- US Foods: Dangerous Pretzel Co. is listed in US Foods catalogs for Northern Utah and Boise. US Foods customers in those areas can order through their US Foods rep. The distributor page says Dangerous Pretzel is available through US Foods in Northern Utah and Boise, and asks a buyer on another distributor to name that distributor on the wholesale inquiry. The page does not name any other distributor. The site does not publish US Foods item codes or prices.
- Ski resorts: wholesale page for ski resorts. Dangerous Pretzel already serves the Goldminer's Daughter at Alta, Brighton, Powder Mountain, Delta Center (Levy) Level 5A, and Fisher Brewing. Paul or Emery from the team can drop off samples.
- Family entertainment: wholesale page for arcades, bowling alleys, roller rinks, trampoline parks, and family entertainment centers. Fully baked, flash-frozen, vacuum-sealed; the account reheats. The published accounts (Goldminer's Daughter at Alta, Brighton, Powder Mountain, Delta Center (Levy) Level 5A, Fisher Brewing) are not a list of arcades or bowling alleys. US Foods customers in Northern Utah and Boise can order through their US Foods rep. Paul or Emery from the team can drop off samples. Case packs and MOQs are not published.
- Ice rinks and arenas: wholesale page for ice rinks, speed-skating ovals, arenas, sports complexes, and rec-center concessions in Utah and Boise. Fully baked, flash-frozen, vacuum-sealed; the account reheats. Delta Center (Levy) Level 5A is the arena proof. The published accounts are not a map of every rink. US Foods customers in Northern Utah and Boise can order through their US Foods rep. Sample drop-off is requested on the wholesale inquiry. Paul or Emery from the team can drop off samples. Case packs and minimums are not published.
- Movie theaters: wholesale page for movie theater and cinema concession stands in Utah and Boise. Fully baked, flash-frozen, vacuum-sealed; the account reheats. A hot, easy-to-hold snack for a captive crowd that pairs with concessions. The published accounts (Goldminer's Daughter at Alta, Brighton, Powder Mountain, Delta Center (Levy) Level 5A, Fisher Brewing) are not a list of theaters. US Foods customers in Northern Utah and Boise can order through their US Foods rep. Sample drop-off is requested on the wholesale inquiry. Paul or Emery from the team can drop off samples. Case packs and minimums are not published.
- Recreation centers: wholesale page for city recreation centers, rec snack bars, and municipal concessions in Utah. Fully baked, flash-frozen, vacuum-sealed; the account reheats. Audience is rec center and municipal concession managers, including when a city issues a vendor RFP or keeps an approved vendor list. No recreation center or city is named as a customer. The published accounts are not a list of recreation centers or cities. US Foods customers in Northern Utah and Boise can order through their US Foods rep. Sample drop-off is requested on the wholesale inquiry. Paul or Emery from the team can drop off samples. Case packs and minimums are not published.
- Become a wholesale customer, samples and contact: How do I get samples? Request a sample drop-off on the wholesale inquiry form on that page. Paul or Emery from the team can drop off samples. Who should contact Dangerous Pretzel / who handles food purchasing? The person who handles food purchasing for the business. The inquiry asks for the business name, a contact name, and the city.
